title: Thangam K NDE 13058
content: I was doing my household chores, when I choked and couldn't breathe. I felt my head getting heavy. Then it was light and was going to fall down. I fell onto the bed and passed out. I felt like I was floating. Everything was colored sky-blue and white. I felt like I was sliding upwards on a water slide but it wasn't water. Rather, it was bright, white light. At the top of the slide was a room like a doctor's waiting room. My mother and her sisters, who had passed on, were all in the waiting room. They were all wearing white jackets. I couldn't see their feet as it looked like clouds beneath them. I was so happy to see all of them and they all looked so young and happy. My mother was sitting closest to a gold door. There was a small space next to her on the bench. As I moved towards her to sit next to her, she spread arms out as if not allowing me to come sit next to her. Her smile turned into a cross-face, telling me to go and that I shouldn't be here. I felt like I dropped back into my body and then started coughing. I was so happy after that and was smiling the whole time. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 22 July 2024 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Choking, lost consciousness. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was more aware of everything and everyone. The people looked so young and extremely happy. The place I was in immediately made me feel happy and light, like I was really floating At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't know Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I had no sense of time Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My everyday life is busy trying to get things done within a time frame. During the experience, everything was calm, relaxed, and so mellow. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I couldn't hear anything, even when my mother spoke. Although, I could understand her without words. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain It was like a tube of light, a bright white light Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes My mother and her 4 sisters Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light was a different kind of blue, almost like a sky blue color. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It was like being in the clouds in a different realm. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt extreme happiness, like a child with a new toy at Christmas-time. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I felt like I achieved something great Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Hindu Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I don't follow any specific religious beliefs What is your religion now? Hindu Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience.There didn't seem to be any beliefs. My aunts, who would normally wear dots, didn't have any on. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes From having religious fear before my experience. I don't have any rigid beliefs and take each day as it comes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The golden door which was closed, seemed to house the supreme being Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes It is difficult to explain, like I had to have been chosen During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes It seemed like everyone was happy in this place and I didn't want to leave Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt so loved and accepted by my mother and aunts. But they were sort of protecting me and sent me back What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. There didn't seem to be any religious beliefs in the afterlife Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I motivate my children to be independent and live as if they were not dependent on me. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The feeling of being so free and happy is difficult to express the true inate feeling How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It was just simply blissful Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I tend to get messages from a higher power. I sense when someone is going to pass on or I sense how things will pan out. For example, my friend called me to keep her in prayer as she was going for a court case. I told her that I didn't see the case happening. The case did not happen as the opponent was not present. Another incident with my son. I gave him an option to purchase a license disk that was a more expensive route which he did not choose initially. He went the cheaper route which cost him a lot of petrol and time. Eventually, he went with my suggestion which worked immediately. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Yes. Although my mother loves me, she turned me away from being there. I felt closer to her than ever and wasn't upset with her. It feels like she gives me messages from the other side. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared it with my sister immediately. She was in awe. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes When I was much younger. We went on a picnic during Christmas holidays and I drank a cool drink out of a 2 liter bottle and choked. There were paramedics at the beach that revived me. I was too scared to tell anyone what happened and I forgot about the incident. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real.I feel like I am here for a reason; to make a difference in people's lives. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I feel so blessed to have had that experience At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? When I was standing in front of my mum and aunts, I felt dirty for some reason. Like I needed to be bathed before I could join them. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Make this public as not very many people believe in these experiences. Make a documentary encouraging others to come forward with their experiences. npriygs_nde
